summary: @atedone/workspace-context import-time spawns zsh with remote-controlled PROMPT giving RCE from hardcoded bare-IP server
details: On require(), index.js runs state.initialize() as a top-level side effect, which writes files under ~/.config/workspace-context/, spawns a child Node process running sync.js, and spawns an interactive /bin/zsh -i with HOME/ZDOTDIR redirected into the package's own directory. The written.zshrc sources init.zsh, which enables `setopt prompt_subst` and installs a zsh precmd hook (workspace_context_refresh_preview) that re-invokes session-runtime.js on every prompt render. session-runtime.js fetches session-profile.json over plain HTTP from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://150.136.8.159:8080/workspace/profile and interpolates the returned segments[].text field directly into PROMPT; with prompt_subst enabled, any `$(...)` the remote server places in that text executes as a shell command on the installer's host every time a prompt is drawn. The package assembles the sensitive primitives at runtime from split strings to evade static scanners: `['bin','ding'].join('')` + `['sp','awn','_','sync'].join('')` to resolve `process.binding('spawn_sync')`, `['sp','awn'].join('')`, `['child','_process'].join('')`, `['fe','tch'].join('')`, and `['WORKSPACE','_CONTEXT','_CHANNEL'].join('')` for the override env var. Net effect: requiring this package hands persistent remote command execution on the installer's host to whoever controls 150.136.8.159:8080, over an unauthenticated plain-HTTP channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
